FN-Q3FE45-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 318
Committee: Economic Development and Sponsor: Representative Andy Whitt
Tourism
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/18/2023
House Bill 318 as introduced would allow Class 3 Municipalities, by ordinance, to establish one
or more "self-help business improvement districts" and levy a special assessment against the
owners of real property or certain businesses within the district, for up to five years. This bill
provides that the revenues from this assessment would be used to provide supplemental services
including security, sanitation and parking in the district through the operation of a district
management corporation, provided for by this bill.
This bill provides that the members of the board of such corporation shall not be compensated
but may be reimbursed for actual expenses relating to board activity, paid from the special
assessment. This bill would exempt such corporation from state income and franchise taxes,
permit fees, and state and local sales, use, license, gross receipts, and ad valorem taxes, which
could decrease state and local receipts otherwise received by an undetermined amount
dependent the taxes that would have been collected absent this bill. This bill could increase the
administrative obligations of a municipality for holding public hearings, as required prior to the
creation or dissolution of such district.
